title: Expense Splitter for Flatmates on iOS
description: Tracks shared bills among housemates, calculates who owes whom with the fewest payments and keeps data on the device with optional export, covering rounding and uneven splits with unit tests.

title: Cross-Platform Campus Map with Offline Tiles
description: Shows building locations and walking routes on a map that works without data after an initial download, comparing storage use and start-up time of two offline tile approaches.

title: Accessibility Audit Tool for Mobile Screens
description: Walks through a running app and flags missing labels, small touch targets and low contrast, producing a report with screenshots and fixes ranked by how many users each issue affects.

title: Medication Reminder App Designed for Older Adults
description: Builds large-type, low-clutter reminders for daily tablets with a caregiver check-in, tested with a few older volunteers and revised twice based on what they struggled with.

title: Augmented Shelf Scanner using Barcodes and Local Lookup
description: Scans product barcodes with the camera, looks details up in a local database first and an online one second, and shows how caching changes speed on a poor connection. Includes a test with deliberately damaged and missing codes.

title: App Size and Start-Up Time Optimisation Study
description: Takes a sample app and reduces its package size and cold start time step by step, recording the measured effect of each change so students learn which optimisations matter most.

title: Language Flashcards with Spaced Repetition on Flutter
description: Implements a spaced repetition scheduler from first principles, stores cards locally and charts how retention changes with different interval rules using simulated study histories.

title: Crowd-Sourced Pothole Reporter with Photo Upload Queue
description: Lets residents report road defects with a photo and location, queues uploads when offline and groups duplicate reports for the council by distance and time. Includes tests for lost connections mid-upload and for repeated submissions of one report.
